items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Pops Foster and Willie Foster? Pops Foster's George Foster, he played the bass? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, I remember them.

ctx.x: Yeah, I do remember something about them. I believe, that's what I was telling you. I think that night I gave that lawn party, I think that was the Magnolia Band I had. I was trying to think of some of the fellas' names, but there was a fella that played trumpet there, he had one leg. And I can't place it. I know old Richie would maybe know who it is. They played a lawn party for me, you know. He had one leg.
Do you remember Pops Foster and Willie Foster? Pops Foster's George Foster, he played the bass?
